INDEPENDENT · UNOFFICIAL FIELD GUIDE

Azeroth Survivors patch notes and game updates

Last updated: November 14, 2026

Field guide

What is Azeroth Survivors?How to playBuildsTier listDownload & fixesSafety checkTalent treeLuck

Aethus’s browser manifest lists v0.143.3, dated November 12, 2026. This update fixes co-op lobby descriptions and changes which characters can appear in lobby text.

v0.143.3 · November 12 · Lobby list fix

A single long word in a lobby description no longer disrupts the lobby list. For a name or description that survives the input filter, use letters or digits in your language and ordinary punctuation. If your party still sees the older interface, update the client before recreating the lobby.

  • Aethus’s current browser release manifest
  • Aethus’s v0.143.3 announcement
  • Co-op and multiplayer

v0.143.2 · November 10 · Browser co-op

The browser release note describes smoother movement in parties of three or more when a teammate’s connection briefly stalls. It also says a run keeps its pace when someone switches browser tabs. If your group has been running from old tabs, reload the game before the next lobby and compare the version shown on each client.

v0.143.1 · Lobby and reconnect behavior

The developer’s notes cover joining a run already in progress, reconnect handling and a timeout for a card choice when the remaining players are waiting. For practical lobby checks, start with the multiplayer guide.

  • Co-op and multiplayer

v0.143.0 · November 9 · Hyper Mode

The option to play through a zone with earlier bosses opens after earning Champion of Naxxramas. Check the unlock, rewards and timing before choosing it for a party or a timed achievement.

  • Hyper Mode unlock and boss timing

v0.142.0 · Native Mac client

The developer announced an Apple silicon desktop client. Check the Mac requirements and the developer’s download route before moving from a browser save.

  • Download & fixes
  • Aethus’s v0.142.0 Mac announcement on Discord

Where to check the next release

Check the developer’s website for the original game and its linked Discord announcements. A US Steam Store search on November 14 returned no matching listing for Azeroth Survivors.
